name: halfdozen-editorial
description: Draft evidence-bound Half Dozen audience articles every 14 days.

interface.shortDescription: Draft an audience-first article every 14 days.
interface.longDescription: Review approved Half Dozen context every 14 days and select the one evidence-bound operating idea most useful to the audience. Technical detail is optional. The plugin creates drafts and evidence ledgers only; it never schedules, publishes, or sends content.
defaultPrompt: Draft the strongest Half Dozen audience article from the last 14 days of approved context.
Rank this approved context for Half Dozen audience relevance and recommend one article.
Audit this Half Dozen draft for unsupported claims, private detail, and reader fit.
